entries.target: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: You bring the power of the storm to bear against your enemy. Striking a Thunderstricken target grants you a stack of Superconductive for 10 seconds, stacking to 20 and increasing the damage of Sky Splitter. Striking a Shocked target will heal you. Healing over your maximum HP lingers, reducing the damage you take from the next hit or until you heal.
